headline: 本周影视：疾速追杀热映，新剧夜行杀机首播
summary: 电影方面，《疾速追杀》领衔本周热作，与《猫鼬》《民宿惊魂》等共同吸睛；剧集方面，《夜行杀机》《末路兼职》《完美的谎言》本周首播，热播剧《侠探杰克》《菜鸟老警》持续升温。

headlineEn: This Week: John Wick Hits Theaters, Night Killers Premieres
summaryEn: On the movie side, John Wick leads this week's hot titles alongside Mongoose and Homestay Horror; on TV, Night Killers, Side Hustle, and Perfect Lie premiere this week, while Reacher and The Rookie stay hot.
